newsitem.title: USA: Homestake Mining Q1 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Homestake Mining Q1 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers) NOTE: Current Q1 includes after-tax gains of $47.2 million or $0.32/shr from break-up fee from Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp upon termination of merger deal, and $8.1 million or $0.06/shr from sale of George Lake and Back River joint venture stakes in Northwest Territories of Canada to Arauco Resources Corp.
Q1 1996 results included after-tax gain of $4.9 million or $0.03/shr from litigation recovery.
Excluding nonrecurring items, Homestake incurred a net loss of $5.4 million or $0.04/shr from operations in 1997 Q1 versus $8.8 million or $0.06/shr in 1996.

The 1997 results reflect the impact of a $48 per ounce decline in the average gold price received, continued heavy investment in exploration and higher depreciation and amortization charges resulting from the acquisition of additional interests in the company's Australian operations and in the Snip mine in Canada during 1996.
